limits: Source-only approval of this exact job. No GUI, world scale, mode or production admission.

Adult MGS2 Ocelot is preserved as a separate incarnation. Original authored zombie transformation, visibly necrotic face and arms, exposed damaged legs, blood and torn brown coat. Not an official costume or absolute retail 1:1 certificate.
Actual corrected left/right passing steps and empty-hand CQC are distinct new drawings. Cropped old reload and replaced figures remain unused. Low shot role9 is a real SAA aim, never a grenade.
Ocelot is ambidextrous with canonical dual SAA. Corrective left reload holds one SAA in the left hand with the right inserting a cartridge; micro-engineering is stylized, not mechanically certified.

Main upper/lower atlas rows have explicitly different source scales. The two-band aliases use real same-band upright references; world/preview scale coherence must pass actual UI before admission. No per-pose height normalization, digital mirroring or pixel changes are approved.
Geometry ownership coverage is alpha>16; softer alpha fringes are not certified. Manual pelvis axes are proposed visual waistband axes, not measured skeletons.
All visual timing deltas are explicitly bound here. Original fighter, sprite, worldHeight, profile, actual move kinds, damage, ammunition and clocks remain unchanged.
